profile.headline: Embedded Software Engineer
profile.summary: Embedded software engineer specializing in real-time systems, RTOS-based architectures, and hardware-adjacent software. Experienced in C/C++ development on microcontrollers, embedded Linux, and networked devices, with recent work in advanced sensing and signal-driven embedded systems. Proven track record of delivering reliable, production-ready firmware in hardware-constrained, performance-critical environments.
